assertion_audit: tests/test_bank_step_speed.py:88-92 fails if the returned sensitivity tensor has the wrong cell, moment, or channel dimensions; its expected dimensions derive from operand shape but the produced shape remains independently checked.
tests/test_bank_step_speed.py:93 fails if any returned sensitivity is NaN or infinite, but a finite wrong channel value still passes.
tests/test_bank_step_speed.py:78 raises when the implementation calls lax.map; reinstating the removed serial map makes the test red, as negative-booking-revert.log records.

No added assertion compares an output numerically against the same supplied input; the new test has no numerical oracle for individual booking channels, while the existing fresh-solve gate checks the composed result.

evidence.profile_note: profile-booking.log declares 189f0988 while the batching source first appears in b8d10f3; converge-booking.log at b8d10f3 independently records a 1490.56 ms warm step.

findings.text: The current-head H200 wall, device time and launch count are absent after two resource-pending submissions; the P100 result at :50 is 1,489.62 ms and 8,687 launches, so the plan's 0.5 ms and 100-launch H200 gate cannot be certified.

The attempted closed-form geometry tangent still differs from the directional reference by 7.77e-5 against a 1e-10 requirement and was removed; support_read.py:763 still invokes the directional tangent, so that required replacement is undelivered.

item_verdicts.diff: Read b8d10f3, 55afd78 and 1dd9553 commit by commit; support_read.py:651 replaces lax.map with vmap, test_bank_step_speed.py:67-93 adds its refusal, and bank-step-speed.html:16-55 and stage-wall.svg record the P100 comparison.
item_verdicts.done_when: The source brief.txt requires an H200 warm step at 0.5 ms and at most 100 launches with geometry parity at 1e-10; bank-step-speed.html:44-55 supplies P100 stage and convergence receipts but no current-head H200 or passing geometry-parity receipt.
item_verdicts.goal: The source brief.txt asks for a closed-form geometry tangent and a faster 550-cell step; support_read.py:651 batches booking channels, while bank-step-speed.html:54-55 records the geometry tangent and H200 target still open.
item_verdicts.manifest: The source manifest.md records three commits since the prior review, complete two-file base and head suite arms, a red serial-map reversal, and explicit H200 and geometry blockers.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The source manifest.md:3 grants support_read.py, test_bank_step_speed.py, the bank-step-speed evidence page and figure directory; git diff 189f0988..1dd9553c changes exactly those four granted paths.

justifications.durability: test_bank_step_speed.py:78 fails if the serial lax.map returns, as negative-booking-revert.log proves; :88-93 checks shape and finiteness but not independent numerical channel values.
justifications.evidence: bank-step-speed.html:41-53 is supported by P100 stage, trace, negative-control and fresh-solve receipts, while its H200 gate is unmeasured and profile-booking.log names pre-commit 189f0988.
justifications.fit: support_read.py:651 changes the existing local-sensitivity owner using the neighboring JAX vectorization idiom, and the added test name at test_bank_step_speed.py:67 describes its behavior.
justifications.goal_fidelity: support_read.py:651 reduces the booking stage, but bank-step-speed.html:54-55 states the closed geometry derivative and H200 limits remain unmet.
justifications.reuse: support_read.py:651 extends its existing _local_booking_sensitivities owner, and the capability search over nova/equilibrium found no added production definition or second booking-sensitivity owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: The four paths in git diff 189f0988..1dd9553c are within the source manifest.md:3 grants and all support the booking-speed change.
